scope: Migrated local PostgreSQL, immutable Evidence, durable typed effects, stale lease takeover and concurrent duplicate delivery with controlled model/tool substitutes.
limitations: The controlled substitutes measure durability, not real-provider diagnosis quality.
Local monotonic timings are not production latency, availability, MTTR or human labor.
Rate-card upper bounds are descriptive and are not provider invoices.
The recovery authority chain is covered by separate exact production-component tests; this probe never creates a real human Approval or infrastructure mutation.
